Name: yoen's closet
Author: yoooen
Description:
[size=6][b][i]DESCRIPTION[/i][/b][/size]
A mod under the Clothing category. It adds 4 shirts and a pair of pants via [u]Fashion Sense[/u]! The clothes are mainly for male farmers, but female farmers can wear them too! This is my first mod, so I really hope you enjoy it!

[size=5][b][i]NOTE[/i][/b][/size]
[size=3]Please note that I use the [url=https://blog.naver.com/codnjsdl8235/222314151470]GH Peach Body Type[/url], as you can see in the thumbnails.[/size]
[b][size=6][i]Requirements[/i][/size][/b]
[color=#D4D4D8]You need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Pathoschild?gameId=1303]Pathoschild[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/PeacefulEnd?gameId=1303]PeacefulEnd[/url] .[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=4][b][i]Where do I put the files?[/i][/b][/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Slide them into the mods folders directly![/size][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=4][b][i]Big thanks to[/i][/b][/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]I want to thank PeacefulEnd for creating Fashion Sense and letting the community make such wonderful clothes through their mod, especially since I have always dreamt of sharing my mods with people.[/size][/color]
